quests.instruction: This line skips two letters each time. Which letter fills the blank? M, P, S, V, __
quests.hint: Look at the jump from M to the next shown letter. Keep making the same jump.
quests.explanation: Y completes the line: M, P, S, V, Y.
quests.funFact: Y is sometimes called 'the sometimes vowel'.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a letter that comes after G in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Check Castle first: it begins with C. Is that letter after G?
quests.explanation: UFO begins with U, which comes after G. Castle begins with C and Dinosaur begins with D, which do not.
quests.funFact: Capital U and V look alike, but U has a curve at the bottom.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with m and has a in the middle?
quests.hint: Check one clue at a time and cross out words that break it.
quests.explanation: map starts with m and has a in the middle. yam and pan break at least one clue.
quests.funFact: A to M is the first half of the alphabet, and M is the last letter in that half.

quests.instruction: Two letters are missing: __, I, __, K, L. Which letters go in the blanks, in order?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet and listen for the two gaps.
quests.explanation: The full line is H, I, J, K, L, so the blanks are H, J.
quests.funFact: H is letter number 8 of the 26 letters, with 7 letters before it and 18 after it.

quests.instruction: Look at cloud. What comes right before its first letter in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Hold the letter in your mind, then count one step forward or back in the alphabet song.
quests.explanation: The first letter of cloud is c. Right before it in the alphabet comes b.
quests.funFact: Words like rabbit and bubble have two b's in a row.

quests.instruction: It begins the word Pear. It comes between o and s. Which letter is it?
quests.hint: Cross out every letter that is outside the first clue. Only a few are left.
quests.explanation: The letters between o and s are p, q and r. Only p begins Pear.
quests.funFact: Lowercase p hangs below the line, like a stick with a circle on top.

quests.instruction: Which word comes last in a dictionary: Pineapple, Paint or Pencil?
quests.hint: All three words start with the same letter. Look at the second letter of each word.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order the words go Paint, Pencil, Pineapple, so Pineapple comes last.
quests.funFact: P says 'puh', a quick puff of air from your lips.

quests.instruction: You sleep on me. I start with the 'buh' sound. What am I?
quests.hint: Say each choice. Does it start with the right sound AND match what I do?
quests.explanation: Bed fits both clues. Bridge starts with the same sound but does not match the second clue.
quests.funFact: For vowel sounds, air flows out of your mouth freely. For many consonants, you squeeze the air a little.

quests.instruction: How many times does the letter E appear in elephant?
quests.hint: Point to each letter as you spell the word, and keep a count.
quests.explanation: elephant is spelled e-l-e-p-h-a-n-t. The letter E appears 2 times.
quests.funFact: The word 'the' is one of the most-used words in English, and it ends with an e.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with e, has a in the middle and ends with r?
quests.hint: Check one clue at a time and cross out words that break it.
quests.explanation: ear starts with e, has a in the middle and ends with r. pan and elf break at least one clue.
quests.funFact: Capital E has one long line and three arms pointing right.

quests.instruction: Find the last letter in panda. Which capital letter matches it?
quests.hint: Say the letter out loud first. Then picture its twin in the other size.
quests.explanation: The last letter of panda is a. Its capital partner is A.
quests.funFact: Capital letters are also called uppercase, and small letters are called lowercase.

quests.instruction: This line goes backwards. Which letter is missing? R, __, P, O, N, M
quests.hint: Each letter comes just before the one on its left. Keep going.
quests.explanation: The full line is R, Q, P, O, N, M, so the missing letter is Q.
quests.funFact: Q is one of the least common letters in English words.

quests.instruction: It begins the word Frog. It comes between C and G. Which letter is it?
quests.hint: Cross out every letter that is outside the first clue. Only a few are left.
quests.explanation: The letters between C and G are D, E and F. Only F begins Frog.
quests.funFact: Fish, frog and fox all begin with F.

quests.instruction: Find the word that uses n and u together.
quests.hint: Cross out any word that has only one of the two letters.
quests.explanation: iguana is spelled i-g-u-a-n-a, so it has both n and u. tent has only n, and juice has only u.
quests.funFact: The letters x, v, w and z are made only of straight lines.

quests.instruction: Which letters fill the two blanks? n, __, p, __, r
quests.hint: Fill the first blank, then the second. Say the whole line to check.
quests.explanation: The full line is n, o, p, q, r, so the blanks are o, q.
quests.funFact: O is letter number 15 of the 26 letters, with 14 letters before it and 11 after it.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a letter that comes after H in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Check Car first: it begins with C. Is that letter after H?
quests.explanation: Otter begins with O, which comes after H. Bird begins with B and Car begins with C, which do not.
quests.funFact: Orange and onion begin with O, but that O sounds different from the O in octopus.

quests.instruction: Put these words in alphabet order: Helicopter, Hat or Honey. Which one goes first?
quests.hint: When the first letters match, the second letters decide the order.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order the words go Hat, Helicopter, Honey, so Hat comes first.
quests.funFact: H teams up with other letters in sh, ch and th to make new sounds.

quests.instruction: Look at diamond. What comes right after its first letter in the alphabet?
quests.hint: First find the first letter of diamond. Then sing the alphabet from there.
quests.explanation: The first letter of diamond is D. Right after it in the alphabet comes E.
quests.funFact: Many words end with a silent e, like cake and bike, and it helps the vowel say its name.

quests.instruction: This line skips one letter each time. Which letter fills the blank? P, R, T, __, X, Z
quests.hint: Count how many letters the line skips each time, then jump again.
quests.explanation: V completes the line: P, R, T, V, X, Z.
quests.funFact: Vest, vase and vine all begin with V.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with w, has e in the middle and ends with b?
quests.hint: Each wrong word matches only some of the clues. Look for the word that matches all of them.
quests.explanation: web starts with w, has e in the middle and ends with b. key and leg break at least one clue.
quests.funFact: W is the only letter whose name has three syllables.

quests.instruction: It comes between F and J. It begins the word Ice. Which letter is it?
quests.hint: List the letters between F and J. Then check which one begins Ice.
quests.explanation: The letters between F and J are G, H and I. Only I begins Ice.
quests.funFact: Capital I is a single tall line; many fonts add little bars at the top and bottom.

quests.instruction: Two letters are missing: M, __, O, __, Q. Which letters go in the blanks, in order?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet and listen for the two gaps.
quests.explanation: The full line is M, N, O, P, Q, so the blanks are N, P.
quests.funFact: In autumn, the last n is silent.

quests.instruction: Look at the first letter of JACKET. Which small letter is its partner?
quests.hint: Say the letter out loud first. Then picture its twin in the other size.
quests.explanation: The first letter of JACKET is J. Its small partner is j.
quests.funFact: Almost no English words end with the letter j.

quests.instruction: Count the letter f in the word waffle. How many do you find?
quests.hint: Point to each letter as you spell the word, and keep a count.
quests.explanation: waffle is spelled w-a-f-f-l-e. The letter f appears 2 times.
quests.funFact: You can stretch out the 'fff' sound, like air slowly leaving a balloon.

quests.instruction: Which word has both s and e in it?
quests.hint: Spell each word out loud and listen for s, then listen for e.
quests.explanation: tennis is spelled t-e-n-n-i-s, so it has both s and e. swim has only s, and joker has only e.
quests.funFact: The tall letters are b, d, f, h, k, l and t.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a letter that comes after O in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Say the alphabet and check where each first letter falls.
quests.explanation: Rhino begins with R, which comes after O. Iguana begins with I and Dress begins with D, which do not.
quests.funFact: R is a sound that takes practice; many children learn it later than other sounds.

quests.instruction: Put these words in alphabet order: Circle, Camel or Cup. Which one goes last?
quests.hint: When the first letters match, the second letters decide the order.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order the words go Camel, Circle, Cup, so Cup comes last.
quests.funFact: C is letter number 3 of the 26 letters, with 2 letters before it and 23 after it.

quests.instruction: Which word has a in the middle and ends with t?
quests.hint: Check one clue at a time and cross out words that break it.
quests.explanation: hat has a in the middle and ends with t. map and van break at least one clue.
quests.funFact: Hippo, hammer and honey all begin with H.

quests.instruction: Put these words in alphabet order: Axe, Ambulance or Angel. Which one goes first?
quests.hint: All three words start with the same letter. Look at the second letter of each word.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order the words go Ambulance, Angel, Axe, so Ambulance comes first.
quests.funFact: A is letter number 1 of the 26 letters, with 0 letters before it and 25 after it.

quests.instruction: It comes after I in the alphabet. It begins the word Up. It is a vowel. Which letter is it?
quests.hint: Make a list of the vowels: A, E, I, O, U. Cross out the ones that break a clue.
quests.explanation: Vowels that come after I are O and U. Only U begins Up.
quests.funFact: U is letter number 21 of the 26 letters, with 20 letters before it and 5 after it.
